title: Past-Due Day Adjustment of the Overdue Tailwise Plus Fee (Pals Rewards and Tailwise Plus)
content:
**Basis.** Because paid benefits stop while a **Pals Rewards and Tailwise Plus** membership is past due, the overdue fee of a past-due Tailwise Plus Annual or Tailwise Plus Premier Annual membership is first adjusted for the past-due days: the calendar days from the date of the declined-fee entry on the rewards history to the collection date.

**Methods.**

| Past-due days | Method applied to the membership fee of the tier held |
|---|---|
| more than 14 | prorated by calendar day over a year of 365 days: the fee times 365 less the past-due days, divided by 365 |
| more than 7, at most 14 | prorated on a 360-day year of twelve 30-day months: the fee times 360 less the past-due days, divided by 360 |
| 7 or fewer | collected unadjusted |

No rounding is made at this stage.

**Both sides (hypothetical days).** 7 days: unadjusted. 8 days: 360-day basis. 14 days: 360-day basis. 15 days: 365-day basis.

**Worked figures (hypothetical, a $59.00 fee).**

| Past-due days | Adjusted fee |
|---|---|
| 5 | $59.00 |
| 10 | $59.00 times 350 divided by 360, which is $57.3611 |
| 20 | $59.00 times 345 divided by 365, which is $55.7671 |
